system.nomenclature_caveat: uploaded XML contains one Ambystoma maculatum label and historical NPS pages use Ambystoma tigrinum; current USGS data release identifies Ambystoma mavortium

high_effort_rule.source_pool: 2021 sites with valid transformed geometry and at least one perc_surveyed=100 visit
high_effort_rule.evaluation_pool: sites present in both years with valid 2021 geometry and at least one perc_surveyed=100 visit in both 2021 and 2022

geometry.transform: 2021 NAD27 EPSG:26713 -> NAD83 EPSG:26913; NAD83 unchanged

sources.evidence: adult metamorphs moved on average >400 m and up to 1 km from breeding tanks
typical post-breeding movement 50-350 m; reported maximum straight-line movement 659 m
sources.source: USGS summary of Bartelt et al. 2023, Ichthyology & Herpetology

movement_worldset_basis.rationale: 500 m captures the broad terrestrial movement scale and 1000 m the documented upper A. mavortium movement; 250 m is omitted because within-site coordinate spread approaches that scale

endpoint.claim_term: observed annual site use, not latent occupancy
endpoint.positive: any AMMA=1 on any visit in the site-year
endpoint.negative: no AMMA=1 on any visit AND at least one visit with perc_surveyed=100

local_reference_aggregation.fish_ever_present: 1 if any Y; 0 if at least one N and no Y; missing otherwise

R0: 2021 target-site AMMA observed annual site-use state

feature_definitions.generic_pond_reachability_fraction_acros: fraction of {500,1000} m worlds containing at least one other source-pool pond
feature_definitions.generic_pond_pressure_mean_across_500_10: mean over 500/1000 m worlds of sum exp(-distance/radius) across other source-pool ponds
feature_definitions.occupied_source_reachability_fraction_ac: fraction of {500,1000} m worlds containing at least one other 2021 AMMA-positive source
feature_definitions.occupied_source_pressure_mean_across_500: mean over 500/1000 m worlds of sum exp(-distance/radius) across other 2021 AMMA-positive sources

spatial_holdout.selection_rule: choose smallest grid with >=5 total blocks, >=80% blocks containing >=3 high-effort evaluation sites, and median block size >=5

evaluation.preprocessing: training-fold numeric median imputation + missingness indicator; training-only standardization of continuous predictors; categorical/binary predictors unstandardized
evaluation.training_class_gate: at least 5 positive and 5 negative 2022 targets

stage1_requirements: response-free 2021 reference table frozen and fingerprinted
all R0/R1/R2/C features fingerprinted before Stage 2
stage2_requirements: same applicability rows used for R0/R1/R2/C
prohibited: inspect PSMA or LISY response values for this fresh lane
change focal taxon after AMMA Stage 1 access
change high-effort rule after response access
change reference variables after response access
change spatial blocks after response access
change model or metrics after response access
promote RMNP back to pristine fresh status
